description: This file defines the CyberArkSecretManager class, a specialized secret manager for interacting with CyberArk Conjur API. It handles authentication, secret retrieval, secret storage, and related configurations. The class extends BaseSecretManager and includes methods for synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: CyberArkSecretManager
classes.description: A secret manager class for interacting with CyberArk Conjur API, supporting authentication, secret read/write, and cache management.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the CyberArkSecretManager with environment configuration, validates credentials, and sets up caching and user privilege checks.

methods.name: str _authenticate(self)
methods.description: Handles authentication with CyberArk Conjur, retrieves or refreshes the session token, and caches it.

methods.name: dict _get_request_headers(self)
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers including authorization token for subsequent API requests.

methods.name: None _ensure_variable_exists(self, secret_name: str)
methods.description: Ensures a secret variable exists in CyberArk by creating a policy entry if needed.

methods.name: str get_url(self, secret_name: str)
methods.description: Constructs the URL for accessing a specific secret, URL-encoding the secret name.

methods.name: Optional[str] async_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a secret value from CyberArk, with caching.

methods.name: Optional[str] sync_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves a secret value from CyberArk, with caching.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] async_write_secret( self, secret_name: str, secret_value: str, description: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, tags: Optional[Union[dict, list]] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret value to CyberArk, ensuring the variable exists beforehand and updating cache.

methods.name: dict async_delete_secret( self, secret_name: str, recovery_window_in_days: Optional[int] = 7, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Attempts to delete a secret but notes that CyberArk Conjur does not support direct deletion; warns user and clears cache.
